name: CoinField
brief: A coin-collecting game: a flat grass arena with a SpawnLocation and 6 gold coins spread over it. Each coin gives the player 1 coin point and disappears when touched.
contract: Each coin is a Part named Coin inside script.Parent, floating about 2 studs above the floor, with CanCollide = false.
Give every player a leaderstats Folder with an IntValue named Coins (start 0).
Touching a coin adds 1 to Coins once and removes the coin (Destroy it).
